test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A car covers a distance of 300 km with uniform speed. The time taken for the journey is one-third of the speed in km/h. The time taken to cover the distance of 300 km is:
solution:
**Given**

Distance = 300 km

Time = speed/3

**Formula used**

Time = Distance/Speed

**Calculation**

let the uniform speed is x km/h

Time = (300/x)

Time = x/3 hours

According to question

(300/x) = x/3

⇒ 300 × 3 = x²

⇒ 900 = x²

⇒ 30 = x

Time taken to cover the distance of 300 km = 30/3

⇒ 10 hours

**∴ Time taken to cover distance of 300 km is 10 hours.**
